Please note, this competition includes only blindfolded events and FMC. If you are interested in non-blindfolded events we recommend signing up to the [Speedcubing Australia mailing list](https://speedcubing.org.au/subscribe/) to be notified as new competitions are announced.

Competitors are strongly encouraged to bring a guest who is familiar with the process of judging blindfolded solving.
